text: Prepare, cook and serve five skilful dishes for a school event to celebrate food from different
cultures. The food may be served hot or cold and should include at least three savoury dishes.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Prepare, cook and serve a balanced main meal that is rich in vitamin D and calcium.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Make a savoury dish using a herb and make a sweet dish using chocolate.

text: Prepare, cook and serve five skilful dishes, each to show the use of a different ingredient from
canned pulses, a cereal, eggs, fresh fruit, fish, a green leafy vegetable, yeast.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Prepare, cook and serve a balanced main meal for two lacto-vegetarian friends.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Make a dish using a coating batter and make a batch of scones.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Prepare, cook and serve three skilful savoury dishes, each to show the use of a different
method of cooking.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Make a sweet dish using the whisking method and make a batch of biscuits.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Prepare, cook and serve three skilful dishes suitable for a packed meal for two construction
workers. The dishes must be suitable for serving cold and eaten without the use of cutlery.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Make a hot savoury dish and a hot sweet dish that the construction workers can eat as part of
their evening meal.

text: Prepare, cook and serve five skilful dishes suitable for serving to a group of five-year-olds at a
birthday party. The dishes may be served hot or cold and three of the dishes must be savoury.
One of the dishes should be a decorated birthday cake.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Prepare, cook and serve a balanced main meal suitable for two convalescents.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Make a savoury dish using flaky pastry and make a batch of small cakes or a tray bake.
